paintOnlyEvidence.scope: All fields except title/source identity, paint values and binding reference hash compare identical; fonts, positions, text, edges, grouping and data flow remain unchanged.

regionChecklist.finding: Boat, bird and cup retain their collection route into the upper Image encoder.
boat/bird/cup chips retain their Text encoder route and the 3x3 matrix retains three diagonal pairing cells plus six off-diagonal comparisons.
Image-to-text, Text-to-image and Symmetric loss remain separate and confined to pre-training.
The two dashed reuse paths still bridge same-modality encoders across the divider annotation and do not imply a matrix-origin route.
New image and class-description inputs reach their respective encoders, then Cosine similarity and Nearest label.
No clipping, overlap, dropped labels, route loss, added title, or footer observed; dark ink remains readable on pale surfaces.

authorizedDeviations: User-authorized paint treatment only: soft dual blue/green roles and warm pairing emphasis replace the accepted baseline colors.
No geometry, text, font, dataflow, route, grouping or semantic revision is accepted by this review.
unresolvedExceptions: No interactive Microsoft PowerPoint edit/reflow session was performed; native object evidence and actual LibreOffice rendering establish structure and appearance only.
